configure_logger: configure a logger to write key-value diagnostics to stdout, log, csv, or tensorboard output formats
logkv_and_dumpkvs: log key-value pairs with logkv then flush all diagnostics to output files with dumpkvs
logkv_mean: log a value with logkv_mean to compute a running average across multiple calls before dumping
profile_decorator: profile a function with the profile decorator to measure and log wall time under a scoped key
scoped_configure: use scoped_configure as a context manager to temporarily switch logger directory and output formats
